description: In-app real-time messaging between users, providers, or support.

screens_added.name: Inbox
screens_added.purpose: All conversations — unread indicator, last message preview

screens_added.name: Shared Media
screens_added.purpose: All files and images shared in conversation

flows_added: Select contact → open thread → send message → receive reply
Receive notification → tap → open thread → reply
Long press message → react / reply / copy / delete
interaction_patterns: Typing indicator — animated dots while other user types
Read receipts — single tick sent, double tick delivered, filled = read
Swipe right on message to reply — quoted message appears in input
Message bubbles — sent right, received left
Long press for context menu — react, reply, copy, delete
Unread count badge on inbox icon

error_flows.ui: Message bubble shows red warning icon on right edge. Tap: 'Message failed to send — tap to retry'. Options: Retry, Delete message. Message remains in thread at correct position. Never silently drop. Retry preserves original timestamp.

error_flows.trigger: File or image fails to send
error_flows.ui: Attachment thumbnail shows red error overlay. Message: 'File failed to send'. File size shown. Options: Retry, Remove. Never show broken image icon in thread permanently.

error_flows.trigger: User blocked attempts to send message
error_flows.ui: Input disabled with message: 'You can no longer message this person'. No toast — persistent state shown in thread header. Do not reveal if user was blocked vs account deactivated.

error_flows.trigger: Message delivery to group fails for some members
error_flows.ui: Delivery receipt shows partial: 'Delivered to 4 of 6'. Tap to see which members. Failed members shown with retry per member option. Never show as fully delivered when not.
Top of chat banner: 'Reconnecting...'. Input disabled during reconnect. Auto-reconnect in background. On reconnect: load missed messages automatically. Banner disappears without user action.
Message shows 'Message removed' placeholder in thread. Sender notified privately: 'Your message was removed — [reason]'. Never silently delete without sender notification.

edge_cases.ui: Allow it — useful as personal notes. Show 'Note to self' label in conversation list. No read receipt shown (would be confusing). No typing indicator.
Show first 300 characters with 'Show more' inline. Full message in thread on expand. Search indexes full content. Never truncate in storage.
Short window (5-10 seconds) to unsend — 'Undo send' toast appears immediately after send. After window: message can be deleted from sender's view only — recipients see 'Message deleted'.

edge_cases.case: Group chat with only one remaining member (all others left)
edge_cases.ui: Show banner: 'You are the only member of this group'. Options: 'Leave group' or 'Invite people'. Input remains active — allow personal notes use case.

edge_cases.case: Message received while device is offline
edge_cases.ui: Push notification queued. On reconnect: messages delivered in order with original timestamps. Badge count accurate. No duplicate notifications.

edge_cases.case: User attempts to re-add a contact they previously blocked
edge_cases.ui: Confirm step: 'You previously blocked [name]. Unblocking will allow them to message you again'. Explicit confirmation required. Previous message history restored.
